title: Cosh
subtitle: Hyperbolic · Catenary
summary: Hyperbolic cosine. Shape of a hanging chain.
detail:
\[ \cosh x = \frac{e^x + e^{-x}}{2} \]

Even function: \(\cosh(-x)=\cosh x\). Range \([1,\infty)\). A hanging flexible chain under gravity forms a catenary \(y=a\cosh(x/a)\). Identity: \(\cosh^2 x-\sinh^2 x=1\).
